# Accessibility and Resilience Rules

Test every important component under:

- keyboard-only use;
- visible focus;
- screen-reader naming;
- touch input;
- grayscale;
- high contrast;
- projector washout;
- 200% text zoom;
- reduced motion;
- narrow mobile;
- long German labels;
- missing icons;
- empty content;
- dense content;
- slow, failed, or interrupted persistence.

## Non-negotiable rules

- Never rely on color alone.
- Long labels may wrap but cannot hide essential meaning.
- Touch targets remain usable.
- Tables remain horizontally readable or transform into stacked records.
- Motion is non-essential and has a reduced-motion fallback.
- Error states preserve user work.
- The user retains access to route context and current state.
- Novel controls expose clear labels and keyboard behavior.
